verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs say agents use tools to accomplish objectives, that a tool is a skill or function agents can use, and that the CLI can scaffold a new tool project, so custom tools are a first-party capability. The pack has no code showing typed tool definitions (argument schemas or type hints) and nothing showing an agent with tools defined in a few lines. missing for 10: typed tool schema/signature documentation, concise agent-plus-custom-tool code example, independent hands-on corroboration of custom tool definition

support.subject: As a developer, I can define an agent with typed custom tools in a few lines of code

citations.quote: A tool in CrewAI is a skill or function that agents can utilize to perform various actions.
Create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project.
